title: Combination Sum
statement:
Generate all nondecreasing combinations that sum to T. A listed candidate may be used any number of times, and duplicate candidate values are allowed in the input.

Input
n T, then n positive integers.

Output
Print the number of combinations. Then print each in lexicographic order as its length followed by its elements.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 16, 0 ≤ T ≤ 35. Candidates lie in [1,50]. The unique combination for T=0 is empty.
